Title: Real-time ML model to predict short-term mortality in critically ill patients (Lim et al., 2024)
Short_Description: Ensemble DL + LightGBM real-time model, externally validated on MIMIC, eICU and AmsterdamUMCdb.
Reported_Metric: Internal AUROC 0.964; External AUROC on MIMIC 0.890

Title: Real-time Mortality Prediction Using MIMIC-IV via Boosted Nonparametric Hazards (Nowroozilarki et al., 2021)
Short_Description: BoXHED survival approach for real-time in-ICU mortality monitoring using time-varying covariates.

Title: Predicting 30-days mortality for MIMIC-III sepsis patients with XGBoost (Hou et al., 2020)
Short_Description: XGBoost vs logistic regression and SAPS-II for sepsis 30-day mortality on MIMIC-III.

Title: Explainable time-series deep learning models for ICU outcomes (Deng et al., 2022)
Short_Description: RNN/GRU/LSTM with attention on MIMIC-IV for mortality, LOS, and readmission (general ICU patients).

Title: XAI for In-hospital Mortality Prediction via Multimodal ICU Data (Li et al., 2023, arXiv)
Short_Description: Multimodal transformer-based model (notes + events + vitals) with explainability (LRPTrans).
Reported_Metric: Competitive AUC-ROC vs baselines (see paper for exact numbers)

Title: Revisiting Clinical Outcome Prediction for MIMIC-IV (Röhr et al., 2024)
Short_Description: Benchmarking clinical outcome prediction tasks on MIMIC-IV (includes in-hospital mortality).
Reported_Metric: Task-specific AUROCs reported in paper (varies by model/task)

Title: Real-time mortality prediction in the ICU (Johnson et al., 2018)
Short_Description: Early work on real-time ICU outcome prediction and sampling schemes for monitoring risk.
Reported_Metric: Benchmark results reported in paper (see link)

Title: XAI for In-hospital Mortality — Multimodal/Transformer (X-MMP / related multimodal works) (Li et al., 2023)
Short_Description: Multimodal transformer integrating notes, events and vitals; highlights explainability and competitive accuracy.

Title: Predicting 30-day mortality for ICU patients with Sepsis-3 (Yu et al., 2024)
Short_Description: ML framework predicting 30-day sepsis mortality using MIMIC-III; compares multiple ML methods.

Title: Learning to predict in-hospital mortality risk with TCN on MIMIC-III (Chen et al., 2022)
Short_Description: Temporal convolutional network (TCN) vs attention-based and other baselines for mortality prediction.

Title: XAI for In-hospital Mortality Prediction via Multimodal ICU Data (alternate listing)
